items: 【Height Adjustable & Flexible】PAULINN RV Sewer Hose Support can be adjusted in height to ensure all water and waste flow continuously. The accordion-style flexibility allows it to snake around obstacles while maintaining drainage efficiency. The elevated design also accommodates the 90° sewer connection elbow you need to have at most RV parks, providing a hassle-free connection.

【Quick Set-Up & Easy Storage】PAULINN Camper Sewer Hose Support is ready to use. NO assembly is required, this hose support folds like an accordion allowing you to set it up quickly and easily. Once waste disposal is complete, effortlessly fold the support and store with the equipped carrying strap.

【Stable & Secure Fit】The widened bottom structure and deep U-design hugs the sewer hose to prevent it from falling. And this RV accessories support kit includes 4 secure rubber band straps to fix the sewer hose, providing added security during waste disposal and eliminating worries about leaks or movement.

【Durable for Long-Lasting Use】Crafted from lightweight, durable, high-quality plastic material, PAULINN Support for camper sewer hose is UV resistant and weatherproof, which withstands temperatures from -40°F winters to scorching summers. It won't crack, warp, or fade, for long-lasting use.

【Complete Sewer Hose Support Kit】PAULINN is compatible with sewer hoses up to 3.3 inches in diameter and 10 feet in length, fitting most types on the market. This swer hose support for RV camper saves time and effort by eliminating the need to manually lift the hose for elevation. Perfect for use at RV dump stations, campgrounds, and RV parks, this kit simplifies waste management and enhances your camping experience.
